job_description:
Software Engineer

This role will be on a fast-moving software engineering team supporting a microservice ecosystem with several UIs. The team is highly collaborative, and engineers are encouraged to help drive system design.
Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain Java microservice web applications.
• Work closely with tech lead on technical decisions and product roadmap.
Required Skills:
• Experience with design, debugging, and problem solving with Java.
• Experience with RESTful web applications.
Nice to Have:
• Full stack experience including UI development with JavaScript (Vue.js).
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience Required: 3 years with Bachelor's degree in technical field, or 7 years without degree

Location: Columbia, MD

Clearance: TS/SCI with Polygraph required

Salary Range: $138,000 - $163,000
